rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Huntkit bundles two MCP servers for OSINT investigations: osint-infra handles infrastructure reconnaissance including WHOIS, DNS lookups, reverse DNS, and Wayback Machine snapshots without requiring API keys, while threat-intel integrates VirusTotal, URLhaus, ThreatFox, and crt.sh certificate transparency for threat intelligence analysis. Both servers integrate into a structured investigation lifecycle with case management, evidence capture, and chain-of-custody protocols. Installable as a Claude Code plugin or via git clone.
